title: phase-u: Strict managed sc-lint adoption and frozen dependency carry-in
description:
## Goal
Adopt the supported sc-lint kit at0.8.5 with every rule strict, preserve complete tests/reporting and carry all already-built dependency work into the same phase. Nothing targets develop directly except the single phase integration PR. Current planning baseline is origin/develop caa43cfca893f81724d30719c8de820c9f8567fd.

## Sprint set
| Sprint | Scope | Hard prerequisites | Release gate |
|---|---|---|---|
| U.1 | Frozen dependency/ADR carry-in; one18-row checklist | none | none |
| U.2 | Strict policy encoding and canonical identity fixtures | U.1; open D1/D2 decisions |0.8.4 evidence sufficient |
| U.3 | Accept finished CLI function seams,8 commits | U.1 | none |
| U.4 | Accept finished Beads function seams,6 commits | U.1 | none |
| U.5 | Accept finished composer function seams,11 commits | U.1 | none |
| U.6 | Windows/PyO3 cross rows and evidence | U.2 | supported0.8.4 rows can start; upstream leak remains blocking if unresolved |
| U.7 | Managed0.8.5 kit/pin/adapter/CI migration | U.6 (therefore U.2) | published0.8.5 kit/native/wheel |
| U.8 | Combined acceptance, whole-phase ending review and landing handoff | U.3,U.4,U.5,U.7 | published0.8.5; final mac/CI proofs |

U.1's table is the only frozen PR checklist. Prior QA PASS is preserved; every row is also reviewed in U.8 aggregate scope. All25 function refactors already exist on fix/lint-function-length at ab07145be770ec2e1140840814bde778ab0288eb based on#841; U.3-U.5 accept that work, never recreate/split/rewrite it. Containers remain open until their delivered work/evidence is accepted; no claim those local commits are already phase-merged.

## Open decisions — NOT approved defaults
D1 OPEN: propose [line_counts] max_production_lines=1000, no exclusions;175 files passed, max807. User must decide before U.2 closes.
D2 OPEN: propose exact forbidden test literals randlee/team-lead/arch-comp/arch-ccomp/comp/comps/team-lead@example.invalid/ATM_HOME, no production owner for those; canonical owners for SC_COMPOSE_DATA_DIR and SC_COMPOSE_TEMPLATE_DIR in template_store.rs, and SC_COMPOSE_TEMPLATE_CONTRACTS_SCOPE in commands/template_lint.rs. Policy input and identity/boundary test drivers consume ONE canonical non-Rust JSON fixture. repo_boundaries.rs:206 must load ATM_HOME from it, not concat! or a lint exemption. User must approve before encoding/closure. No policy is presumed approved and no justified exception is currently proposed.

## Follow-on prose only — no reserved sprint numbers
Held toml1, quick-xml0.42, MiniJinja3, clap/serde/thiserror and duplicate-version bumps are separate follow-on work after this strict contract and phase acceptance. They have no sprint here. Already-built updates in U.1 remain frozen; do not re-plan them or the already-fixed inventory/dev-edge/Zlib work. No advisory/Clippy/identity/size exception is authorized.
design:
## Boundary map
- BOUNDARY-ScCompose owns sc-lint process invocation/normalization/report HTML and root developer orchestration; sc-lint owns rules and envelopes. Preserve fixed executable/allowlisted descriptors (ADR0016/0017).
- BOUNDARY-ScComposer stays pure: private completed composition/extraction/schema changes preserve API/diagnostic/span semantics; no CLI/ATM dependencies.
- BOUNDARY-ScComposerBeads retains host-neutral argv/receipts/graph/quoting; no test-support dependency reintroduction (ADR0021/0023).
- Directed edges stay CLI->composer/beads, beads->composer, composer->sc-sha, Python/Go adapters->owned libraries. Inventory corrections#836, Zlib removal#837, dev-edge removal#838, YAML advisory repair#839, generator repair#840 and stale workspace cleanup#841 are finished inputs, not new scope.

## Delivery and one writer
One explicit linear phase stack: integrate/phase-u is the bottom branch, created by the lead from current origin/develop caa43cfc. The current observed#825 trunk is develop; that is historical state to migrate, NOT the planned landing trunk. #831 is logically first beneath dependency work, also targets integrate/phase-u. No individual dependency or sprint PR lands directly on develop. The only final develop PR is integrate/phase-u -> develop, gated by phase-ending review/user approval and merged by the lead with gh stack merge. A new stack number after relink must be recorded; do not assume825 survives.

Lead-run steps requiring user go-ahead, never dev tasks: (1) create integration root from current develop; (2) mechanical rebase/relink of#831 then the17 existing#825 rows onto that root while preserving frozen content, one authoritative old->new head mapping and QA provenance; (3) compose the finished25-commit function branch with#842 docs so neither is lost (#841, not#842, is the function branch base); (4) before landing fetch updated origin/develop and sync/rebase the WHOLE phase stack onto the new develop via the single stack writer, with sufficient head/base/containment/content-conflict evidence, not an ad-hoc merge of develop only into the bottom; (5) freeze trunk writers from final sync through landing, repeat acceptance/CI/review on any changed candidate; (6) after U.8 PASS and explicit user approval, lead gh stack merge by current stack number, merge commits only. No stack write is performed by this plan-authoring task.

Frozen means no developer content edits. The user-authorized lead mechanical rebase/relink is the scoped exception for migrating the old trunk; if a content defect is found, fix on a new top layer. Missing/unknown hosted mergeability or lower-layer red CI is not rewritten here; QA/CI gate the final combined candidate. Every frozen PR row must be landed into Phase U or explicitly dropped by the authorized decision, never forgotten. Final develop integration waits for the whole-phase ending review.

## Sanity and closure
Per explicit lead ruling, dev-sanity is read-only verification of its sprint's numbered deliverables, no lint execution and not QA. Global strict lint debt is not a hidden blocker for independent completed seam acceptance. Only U.8 owns aggregate green and phase-ending review. No layer lands and the phase never closes before that gate passes. Other groups/QA are poured later by the installed orchestrator, not created manually here.

## Release and technical contract
0.8.5 is an explicit release gate, not assumed published. Confirm kit/native/wheel versions, helper policy/default profile/logging/artifacts support, corrected managed Python PATH, ARM64 support and packaged pytests fix from the actual released artifact before U.7/U.8. Retain packaged pytests; do not omit it to pass0.8.4. The sc-lint lead confirmed work lint-085.18/QA lint-085.19; research handoffs are in /Users/randlee/.codex/reports/sc-lint-0.8.4-adoption-plan-20261103/upstream-confirmed-reply*.txt.
Analyzer exit10 keeps ok:true/data.findings; helper exit5 has ok:false/error.details.findings, capped10 plus true findings_count. Preserve raw exit/envelope and true totals. Config errors3/usage2/profile.steps_failed failed_steps[{index,name,exit_code,message,step_log_destination?,step_log_error?}]. Version uses data.version+self_contained. Never let the consumer reporter's legacy Findings exit0 make a strict gate green.

## Waves/ownership
U.2/U.3/U.4/U.5 follow accepted frozen baseline and have disjoint implementation/verification file fences; U.6 consumes U.2 policy; U.7 consumes complete policy/cross declarations; U.8 accepts all. Critical path5 (U.1->U.2->U.6->U.7->U.8), width4, sprint count8. That five-deep path carries actual artifacts: fixed baseline->policy->cross declarations->managed kit->aggregate. Existing source work is reused, not serially reimplemented. Physical append order follows the declared sprint branches, even for semantically independent scope; no independent phase roots/forks. Plan metadata names no assignee.

The committed docs/phase-u/beads-plan.jsonl is the frozen pre-import payload for lead review/import, not an alternate runtime plan. Vars/partial renders stay outside the repo. After confirmed import, Beads is authoritative and this snapshot is historical import evidence; no parallel Markdown sprint docs or synchronization process are introduced.
acceptance_criteria:
1. On the COMPLETE integrate/phase-u candidate, just setup, just lint and just test exit0 on macOS, followed by required Linux/Windows/LinuxARM64 CI green. All rules strict, zero disables, no advisory ignores/growth allowances; real consumer tests execute, not only report rendering. Explicit just lint "" all proves typed Windows cross rows; scope/host skips never count as coverage.
2. U.8 phase-ending review follows U-acceptance, reviews EVERY Phase U change in the full develop-to-complete-integrate/phase-u diff, including all U.1 PR rows, ADR#831,25 local function commits and later policy/kit/CI changes. Prior per-layer QA remains valid as prior evidence but cannot substitute for aggregate review.
3. Every U.1 row is accounted for as landed into Phase U or explicitly dropped, with reviewed content preserved. No phase closure or develop integration before row accounting, aggregate review PASS and explicit user go-ahead.
4. Lead-only rebase/relink onto integrate/phase-u and final whole-stack sync onto fresh develop are completed with exact-head evidence before landing; changed heads invalidate old runtime proofs and require refreshed final acceptance. Merge is lead-run gh stack merge, never a dev shortcut.
5. D1 and D2 stay open until user decisions are recorded. No exception is assumed. No flaky timing/sleep/race/event-loop-order tests: any identified flake is redesigned with controlled inputs/synchronization.
6. This planning deliverable is local only: no bead import, push, PR opening or stack mutation until lead confirmation. Hardening is capped at two rounds.

7. Before merge, every frozen row is checked as included in the complete reviewed candidate or explicitly user-dropped; after authorized merge the lead stamps actual landed/dropped dispositions on the same U.1 table before phase closure. Do not create a cycle by requiring actual PR merges before the no-layer-landing acceptance gate.

title: u-2: strict-policy-encoding
description:
## Deliverables
1. Once OPEN D1/D2 are explicitly decided, encode required line_counts/identities/version_sync/cargo_shear policy in sc-lint.toml and prove it with the released0.8.4 product. Do not wait for0.8.5 just to encode policy; do not claim0.8.4 kit convergence. D1 proposed1000 production lines, no exclusions. Version sync includes Cargo.lock and all3 Python manifests.
2. For approved D2, author ONE non-Rust canonical fixture JSON shared by policy input and identity/boundary test drivers; include ATM_HOME only with repo_boundaries.rs replacing concat! with that canonical lookup. Canonical store env names become constants at template_store.rs and commands consume them without changing error text. No obfuscation/site allow/path exemption or new raw operator identities.
3. Enable every boundary/portability/runtime rule strictly and meaningful policy tables, zero function-growth allowances. Do not repeat#836/#837/#838/#841 repairs or revive the .just helper fallback. Retain only the product-required tracked zero-allowance baseline data, not copied scripts.
4. Provide the approved policy fields as the input artifact consumed unchanged by U.6/U.7; the old executable pin is not changed to an invented intermediate version by this encoding sprint.
design: D1/D2 are OPEN user decisions in root description; no defaults silently become acceptance. Supported helper tables can be proven with explicit0.8.4 invocations independently of the unreleased kit. Final managed ownership/0.8.5 pin belongs to U.7, which consumes this policy rather than editing a managed file after rendering. Test token data use serde_json/include_str or a fixture loader, no new production dependency.
acceptance_criteria: Record D1/D2 decisions before closing. Run cargo test --workspace; targeted identity/boundary/CLI diagnostics tests; exact0.8.4 line-count/identity/version checks with explicit config and interpreter. Evidence: comp probe on ee01fa76 had version_sync(all3 Python manifests), prod1000 and compatibility PASS; the intentional ATM_HOME test finding must disappear through shared fixture data, not exemption. Independent full aggregate debt may be reported but never waived; final green belongs U.8. Sanity checks deliverables/evidence read-only.

title: u-6: windows-cross-rows
description:
## Deliverables
1. title: u-8: aggregate-acceptance
description:
## RELEASE-GATED: published0.8.5; final acceptance on complete integrate/phase-u candidate
## Deliverables
1. Lead exposes the COMPLETE combined Phase U candidate for integrate/phase-u, including frozen dependency/ADR table, all25 function commits and every new policy/cross/kit/CI change. Do not run acceptance on the untouched integration root or substitute a last-sprint-only diff. If lead's authorized composition is not present, stay blocked rather than mislabeling another head as integrate/phase-u.
2. On that exact candidate macOS just setup, just lint AND just test exit0, with real consumer tests; additionally just lint "" all proves typed Windows cross rows. Then hosted Linux/Windows/LinuxARM64 CI is green. Every rule strict, zero disables/ignores/function-growth allowances. Kit dry-run0 and complete raw/HTML/log artifacts persist. No skips masquerade as test/cross coverage.
3. After U-acceptance, perform ONE light phase-ending review of EVERY Phase U change: full develop-to-complete-integrate/phase-u diff, using EACH U.1 table row as checklist, plus25 function commits and all new sprint changes. Prior per-layer QA PASS stays recorded; this is aggregate review on top, not rerunning isolated reviews or reviewing only the new sprints.
4. Before acceptance PASS, account every frozen row as contained in the reviewed complete Phase U candidate or explicitly dropped by authorized decision; review the full integration diff against develop, not a package/file filter. No row disappears through a rebase/forgotten PR. After the separately authorized merge, the lead updates this SAME checklist to actual landed/dropped dispositions before closing the PHASE. Actual landing is a phase-close postcondition, not a circular prerequisite demanding PRs merge before the no-layer-landing gate passes. Resolve confirmed defects on new top layers; no flaky retries/sleeps/races.
5. Lead-run landing handoff: user-go for rebase/relink, refresh origin/develop and whole-stack sync onto NEW develop before landing, record new heads/stack number, freeze trunk writers and rerun final proofs/review if candidate changes. Only after aggregate/phase-ending review PASS and explicit user approval does the sole stack writer gh stack merge the phase, including the single integrate/phase-u -> develop PR. No dev merge, no direct dependency-PR -> develop merge, no partial layer landing before this gate.
design: This final acceptance owns global closure; other sanity gates check only their numbered scope. Phase-ending review scope is the full comparison develop -> integrate/phase-u (e.g. git diff origin/develop...integrate/phase-u with an explicit recorded candidate head), including every frozen row and later changes. Integration is a bottom/root PR with ordered descendants; lead must materialize/verify the complete candidate according to authorized stack composition and the phase integration rule before claiming it tested. No empty-root acceptance. Lead-only sync/relink/user-go are runtime gates, never developer permissions or actions by this planning task.
acceptance_criteria: cargo test --workspace; fresh macOS just setup && just lint && just test all exit0; required just lint "" all exits0 with selected Windows rows EXECUTED; Linux/Windows/LinuxARM64 required CI green on same composed content. Every U.1 row accounted before merge as included-in-reviewed-candidate or explicitly dropped, and full-phase ending review PASS after acceptance; actual landed/dropped dispositions are verified by the lead after authorized merge and before phase close. Final sync onto new develop leaves content/head evidence current; any changed candidate repeats affected acceptance before user-approved lead merge. Phase cannot close and no layer lands until all these pass. No extra ceremony beyond this final step and U.1 table; hardening max2 rounds.
